name: Dennou Yousei ~Cyber Fairy~
original_name: 電脳妖精 ～サイバーフェアリー～
source:
Main character is a student in a pubertal period. He saves money for an erotic game, and from the disc box pc fairy shows up. She asks what wish he's willing to fulfill. He has only one wish... 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-march-2002-kikokugai-cyber.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名正值青春期的学生。他存钱买色情游戏，光盘盒里的电脑仙女出现了。她问他愿意实现什么愿望。他只有一个愿望…… 

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-march-2002-kikokugai-cyber.html]vndbreview[/url]]
